legacy_maxwell_audit.reason: The two endpoints of every reported legacy transition interval have unequal pressure and unequal baryon chemical potential. The finite reported delta-epsilon does not establish a Maxwell coexistence point.
legacy_maxwell_audit.exact_maxwell_acceptance: Require one common (P_t, mu_t) with two distinct one-sided n_B and epsilon values, plus delta_epsilon=mu_t*delta_n_B.

source_catalog.source_units: CompOSE source tables; n_B in fm^-3; Q columns dimensionless; m_n,m_p and mu_B in MeV; P, epsilon in MeV fm^-3.

q_fields.Nadd: Count of provider-defined additional eos.thermo columns; meaning must be taken from that model's Data Sheet. Preserve all values and ordering.

source_catalog.composition_fields: eos.compo is retained as a structured source: Iphase, Npairs particle pairs, Nquad nucleus quadruples. Iphase is provider-defined, not a universal physical phase label. Y_I is the nuclear number-density fraction; Y_h=Abar*Y_I.

adapter_level_gates.policy: STRICT_REJECT_DEFAULT; a looser value or a Q3 projection requires an explicitly selected repair mode and a per-knot receipt.
adapter_level_gates.density_reconstruction: Record reconstructed_n_max_rel. It is not currently part of ns_table_eos fully_admitted; no numerical acceptance threshold is set in this manifest. Until a threshold is approved and sensitivity-tested, density drift remains REVIEW_REQUIRED and cannot be silently admitted.
adapter_level_gates.composition: Preserve eos.compo rows and semantics. Do not delete them merely to satisfy the current constructor.
adapter_level_gates.Nadd: Preserve the extra column byte/row-wise. No generic interpolation or deletion until the provider Data Sheet meaning is resolved.
adapter_level_gates.Iphase: Preserve original IDs and knot positions; split the EOS into explicit source segments. No interpolation or derivative stencil may cross a change of Iphase.
adapter_level_gates.rest_mass: Use source mn/mp headers to reconstruct dimensional thermodynamics. No inherited smooth-matcher gauge shift. A reference-mass transformation must be explicit, applied consistently to epsilon and mu, and logged as a thermodynamic repair.
adapter_level_gates.causality: Report FULL_SOURCE and CAUSAL_DOMAIN results separately. No silent truncation or causal completion.
adapter_level_gates.root_selection: Isolate every stationary point/root on the common mu_B support. Accept exactly one root; preserve NO_ROOT and MULTIPLE_ROOT as terminal scientific outcomes.
adapter_level_gates.output_identity: All successful new results live only in sharp_maxwell/. Legacy maxwell files are immutable.

required_transition_checks: whole-interval mechanical stability and causality on each smooth segment

solver_scope.current_native_tov_cowling: Two input table providers (high-density core and low-density envelope), one sharp Maxwell interface, separate side callbacks, one-sided interface states.
solver_scope.current_gap: Each crust source has two Iphase segments (0 and 7). The current TOV provider is one smooth table per side; it does not yet represent a multi-segment crust envelope plus core with all source interfaces retained.
solver_scope.stop_condition: Do not invoke TOV/Cowling for any pair until the input segments and all physical interfaces are represented without smoothing or dropping source phases.
solver_scope.modes: Only after admitted structure and stable-branch checks: compute slow and rapid conversion spectra separately.

next_research_steps: C4: validate the 18 raw source files and all grid alignment, monotonicity, thermodynamic, composition, and whole-interval causality properties; record exact failing rows/intervals.
Resolve provider Data Sheet semantics for every Nadd and Iphase transition; keep unknown semantics as unresolved rather than guessing.

Design a multi-segment crust envelope / explicit phase-chain provider compatible with the one-interface sharp Maxwell core-crust transition, or document a justified alternative without dropping source segments.
Select and justify the density-reconstruction drift acceptance threshold by resolution/refinement and observable-sensitivity studies.
Only after these gates: implement adapter, generate one of the 65 pairs, independently verify its exact coexistence point, then scale to the full 65 sweep.
